title: Building a dark fantasy ARPG in Godot with the help of AI
author: Tap_Little
selftext:
I’m building a dark fantasy ARPG in Godot with the help of AI.

You play as a tiny hamster exploring a huge, hostile world and fighting giant insects.

I’ve been using AI throughout the development process while putting everything together in Godot, especially for parts of the art, assets, and general production workflow.

I’m aiming for Diablo-style combat, loot, and progression, but everything is designed around the scale of a tiny hamster.

The overall atmosphere is finally starting to go in the direction I had in mind, so I wanted to share where the game is at right now.

replies.author: Kagemand
replies.body: Did Claude create, rig and animate all characters or did you use other tools for it, can you elaborate? Thanks.

replies.author: Tap_Little
replies.body: I made the characters with Meshy AI, and Opus 5.5 handled the rigging. I use AI in other parts of the workflow too, but that’s the basic character pipeline.
